hookups.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/goose-creek-state-park/camping ('The RV camping area has 22 sites that all have full hook-ups (electric, water and sewer)') + ReserveAmerica site list, loop 'Goose Creek RV Campground' (all 22 'Campsite Electric' sites: 'Electric Hookup available: 50 amp', 'Full Hookup available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 22 RV sites (one wheelchair accessible), each with a tent pad; 21 list a 40-ft back-in driveway, site 028 a back-in with no length given. Six camper cabins share the loop; a separate primitive tent area (14 sites) and two group tent sites are elsewhere.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/goose-creek-state-park/camping ('The RV camping area has 22 sites') + ReserveAmerica site list, loop 'Goose Creek RV Campground' (driveway column '40 Back-In' on 21 sites, 'Back-In' on site 028), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/goose-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552810 ('Status: Open year round'; 'There is 24-hour access to the primitive and RV campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booking page: 'Campsite Electric ... Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance.' Its holiday rule: '2 nights Minimum Stay on holiday weekend (Friday/Saturday or Saturday/Sunday)' for Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day, with no waiver stated on this park's page (other NC parks' booking pages lift it within 14 days of arrival; the statewide ncparks.gov page says within 7 days).

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/goose-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552810 (Booking Window; 'Business rules for Holiday Weekends'), read 2026-10-22

note: Newer RV loop shared with six camper cabins; bathhouse near the loop entrance. Main entrance via Camp Leach Road closed from Aug 24, 2026 for bridge work on Upper Goose Creek; detour via NC 92/Whitepost (park alert, read 2026-10-22). --Claude
summary: Confirmed 22 full-hookup sites (now 50-amp electric from the booking site), 40-ft back-in driveways, no pull-throughs, reservable on ReserveAmerica. Added year-round (booking site status), 6-month window with same-day booking, the holiday 2-night minimum as this park's page states it (no waiver given). Fees ($45 incl. $3/night reservation fee; RA table $42 Campsite Electric 2026 and 2027) stand. Not stated: showers (only 'bathhouse'), dump station, walk-up sites, max stay.
flags: Phone: entry has 252-923-2191; ncparks.gov's park page (Visitor Center) and the ReserveAmerica page ('For phone inquiries, please call : 252-507-6456') give 252-507-6456.

Access (not a closure): park alert says the main entryway via Camp Leach Road is closed from August 24 for bridge work on Upper Goose Creek; enter via Rt. 92/Whitepost. Campground itself open (RA: 24-hour access to the RV campground).

Holiday minimum: this park's ReserveAmerica rule states the 2-night holiday minimum with no waiver; the state:NC row's 7-day waiver (statewide page) and other parks' 14-day RA waiver are not stated here. Recorded without a waiver.
